title: Entrant Impact Probability Playbook: Tactical Market & Model-Landscape Signals
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Problem: We need an operational, repeatable rubric that turns noisy external signals about new model entrants (open-source releases, vendor promos, hardware-specific quantized builds) into a probabilistic estimate of customer impact and prescriptive GTM + provisioning actions.

Scope: Build a playbook and lightweight scoring system (CSV/Notion + automated signal ingestion stub) that maps signals -> probability of material impact (low/medium/high) over 3 time horizons (14d, 90d, 12mo) and recommends immediate actions (monitor, sales outreach, pre-provision Dedicated capacity, create fallback route). This ticket covers the first MVP: scoring rubric, list of signals & weights, example signaled event syntheses, and handoff UX requirements for Console/Incidents teams.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A documented scoring rubric with at least 10 signals and defensible weightings published in Drive (MVP doc link in Links)
A2: Example scoring runs for three hypothetical entrants (OSS-small, OSS-large, Commercial-variant) with final probability buckets for 14d/90d/12mo
A3: Decision matrix mapping probability buckets to actions (monitor / prioritize model-onboard / sales-alert / pre-provision) with owner for each action
A4: Lightweight data schema (CSV columns) for automated signals ingestion prototype
A5: Review and alignment with Growth (sales), Eng (runtime), and Security; sign-off recorded in comments
signals_and_weights: hardware_affinity: known to run well on A100/RTX/H100 (weight 2)
latency_delta: benchmarked median latency change vs our catalog (weight 3)
throughput_gain: whether 2x+ throughput at comparable cost (weight 3)
vendor_go-to-market_push: announced managed offering / cloud partnership (weight 2)
region_availability: presence in APAC/EU vs US only (weight 1)
example_scenarios: Scenario A — OSS-small: community release, no quantization, moderate latency improvements -> Score=0.28 -> 14d: monitor, 90d: experimental onboarding by Research team

Scenario B — Commercial-variant: vendor announces managed API with quantized runtimes and enterprise connectors -> Score=0.82 -> 14d: sales alert + legal triage, 90d: prepare Dedicated trial capacity, 12mo: procurement playbook
Scenario C — Hardware-optimized fork: quantized release tuned for low-cost edge hardware, throughput 3x -> Score=0.69 -> 14d: perf lab validation, 90d: prioritize model onboarding for edge customers
decision_matrix: Low (<=0.35): Add to watchlist, daily signal sampling, no immediate infra changes
Medium (0.36-0.65): Engage Research for benchmark slots, add to canary pool if matches core infra
High (>0.65): Trigger sales outreach, legal license review, consider pre-provision Dedicated units and canary routes in-hosted
